name: Angel Clawd Is Flat Pixel-Sticker Mascot Art, a Recorded Exception to the House Register
summary: The angel-clawd motif deliberately renders in a DIFFERENT medium than the universe's warm-editorial ink-and-wash register: flat pixel-sticker mascot art, generated by gpt-image-2 from the canonical Clawd screenshot with NO register anchor and NO register poles.
rules: The house register (warm editorial ink-and-wash, anchor passed first) governs every model render in this universe. angel-clawd is the recorded exception: it is merch-facing pixel-mascot art, so no register anchor, style pack, or rejected-pole negative applies to its shots. Since 2026-08-08 it is produced by gpt-image-2 through the framework provider adapter (on-brand-image), with reference/angel-clawd/source/clawd-flag-screenshot.png passed first as the identity reference, shot on a solid chroma-green field and keyed to transparency with the framework chroma keyer. The deterministic angel-clawd-pixel generator (SPEC 4.11) that first produced this motif is SUPERSEDED: Gary reviewed its proof sheet on 2026-08-08 and rejected the rigid rectangle-port look; the generator stays on disk as history and its outputs are not deliverables. Do not 'fix' the mascot's flatness toward the register, and do not cast it into a model-rendered spread without an explicit new decision from Gary. This record exists so the exception is a canon fact rather than a silent violation someone later reconciles in the wrong direction. RETIRED 2026-08-15 (Anthropic campaign concluded, per Gary): both subjects of this exception, clawd and angel-clawd, are archived (lifecycle: archived, see their entity records), so this register exception governs no live casting. The record is kept, not deleted, because it explains shipped merch art and the archived entities' plates; if either mascot is ever unarchived, this exception resumes with it. Craft records have no lifecycle field in the schema (framework gap flagged 2026-08-15), so this dated note is the retirement marker.
origin: Angel Clawd entity registration, 2026-08-08: adapted from the TastefulStories.com cooking-screen Clawd (tastefulstories/src/app/story/Clawd.tsx) and the Claude Code pixel mascot, for Gary's Anthropic-evangelism shirts. Same day: Gary rejected the deterministic pixel-port look and redirected production to gpt-image-2 reinterpretation. Precedent: winged-startup, which likewise carries its own plate-register rules inside an ink-and-wash universe via invariants prose.
